subject: Block Coding
arc_note: REVISED 2026-06-13: every G3 sheet must exercise REPEATING EVENTS (loops). The G3 rubric scores a sequential/concurrent-only sheet at C1-L2 ('under-reaches G3'), so it can never clear the 19/20 bar. The arc is therefore loop-centric: each sheet is a distinct loop skill (count → draw/pattern → event-triggered → concurrent → read/alter → debug), not a separate sequencing/events sheet. Flag for user at the Phase D batch gate.

topics.title: Loops: Code That Repeats
topics.concept: count-controlled repeat loop — how many times the inside runs

topics.title: Loops That Make Patterns
topics.concept: repeat a small action to build a repeating pattern (beads/stamps)

topics.title: Start It, Then Repeat
topics.concept: an event (when flag clicked) starts a script that repeats

topics.title: Two Sprites, Both Repeating
topics.concept: concurrent scripts that each loop at the same time

topics.title: Read and Change a Loop
topics.concept: read an existing loop, change its count/contents, predict the new outcome (C3.2)

topics.title: Loop a Longer Pattern
topics.concept: repeat a multi-step pattern (e.g. clap-clap-stomp) — every inside block runs each pass

topics.title: Find the Loop Bug
topics.concept: read a broken loop, find the wrong number/block, fix it (C3.2 debugging)
